Code No. 11461 / CBCS
FACULTY OF ENGINEERING
B.E. (CSE) IV - Semester (CBCS) (Main & Backlog) Examination, May / June 2019
Subject : Programming Languages
Time : 3 Hours Max. Marks: 70
Note: Answer all questions from Part-A & any five questions from Part-B.

PART — A (20 Marks)

1 Write important uses of programming languages. (2)
2 Write the differences between compder and interpreter. (2)
3 What is backward chaining and forward chaining inferencing? (2)
4 What is an alias? (2)
5 What is Named constant? Give an example. (2)
6 What's short circuit evaluation? (2)
7 What are guarded commands? (2)
8 What is a variable and what are the attributes of a variable? (2)
9 Define template. Give example. (2)
10 Write the differences between logic programming and concurrent Programming. (2)

PART — B (50 Marks)
11 (@) Discuss features of programming languages and its importance. (5)
(b) Draw the syntax tree for Farid +ef.
12 (@) Distinguish between gate types, arrays and records. (5)
(b) What is call-by-value and call-by-reference? Give example. (5)
13 (a) What are record value types? (6)
(b) Explain concurrency mechanism in Ada. (5)
14 Explain the Concept of inheritance with example. (10)
15 (a) Explain logic programming language features. (5)
(b) Write on scheme programming language. (6)
16 Explain the various approaches for expression evaluation in functional programming language. (10)
17 Write short notes on (10)
(a) Abstract data types
(b) Polymorphism.
